items.exampleEn: The thief spent two years in prison.
items.exampleZh: 那個小偷在監獄裡待了兩年。

items.exampleEn: The police could not find out the man's identity.
items.exampleZh: 警方查不出那名男子的身分。

items.exampleEn: Justice was done when the real thief was caught.
items.exampleZh: 真正的小偷被抓到時，正義得到了伸張。

items.exampleEn: The application form asks for your phone number.
items.exampleZh: 申請表上要填你的電話號碼。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather was a cook in the army.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺以前在軍隊裡當廚師。

items.exampleEn: In the game, you must hide from your enemies.
items.exampleZh: 在這個遊戲裡，你必須躲避敵人。

items.exampleEn: Fire regulations say this door must stay closed.
items.exampleZh: 消防法規規定這扇門必須保持關閉。

items.exampleEn: He declared that he would never eat meat again.
items.exampleZh: 他宣布自己再也不吃肉了。

items.sentenceEn: Please show your identity card at the gate.
items.sentenceZh: 請在大門出示你的身分證。

items.audioEn: All visitors must wear a visitor card. It is a new safety regulation.
items.audioZh: 所有訪客都必須配戴訪客證，這是新的安全規定。
items.questionZh: 為什麼訪客要配戴訪客證？
options: The cards help visitors find rooms.
It is a new safety rule.

items.sentenceEn: Cats and dogs are not always enemies.
The new regulation starts next month.
items.sentenceZh: 新規定下個月開始實施。

items.stemEn: The teacher will ____ the winner of the drawing contest tomorrow.
items.stemZh: 老師明天會宣布繪畫比賽的優勝者。

items.stemEn: The ____ built a new bridge over the river in just two weeks.
items.stemZh: 軍隊只花兩週就在河上蓋了一座新橋。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, we visited an old prison that is now a museum. Long ago, the army used it to hold enemy soldiers during a war. Later, it became a normal prison, and in 1990 the town declared it a historic building. Because of new safety regulations, every visitor has to show an identity card at the entrance. One room tells the story of a young lawyer who fought for justice for the prisoners. Before we left, I filled in an application to work there as a volunteer in the summer.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們參觀了一座現在已改成博物館的老監獄。很久以前，軍隊在一場戰爭中用它來關押敵方士兵。後來它成為一般的監獄，1990 年鎮上宣布它為歷史建築。由於新的安全規定，每位參觀者在入口都必須出示身分證。有一個展間講述一位年輕律師為囚犯爭取正義的故事。離開前，我填了一份申請表，想在暑假去那裡當志工。

questions.questionZh: 由於新的安全規定，參觀者在入口要做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我昨天寄出了大學申請表。
referenceEn: I sent my university application yesterday.
Yesterday I sent my application to the university.
rubricZh: application 表示「申請、申請書」，例如 send an application 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 justice 造一個句子，說說你對公平正義的看法。
referenceEn: I like stories where justice wins in the end.
rubricZh: justice 表示「正義、公平」，是不可數名詞，例如 fight for justice 等說法
說的是自己的看法或喜好（例如 I think）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
